candidates.title: Prepare administrator reports and meeting materials

demandEvidence.chore: Prepare reports, meeting materials and other documents for an administrator role.
demandEvidence.evidenceQuote: Förbereda rapporter, mötesunderlag och andra dokument

ease.reason: A beginner can test a report draft with fictional operator-supplied notes, but the notice specifies no format or tools.

profit.reason: Hypothesis: professional offices may value help preparing routine materials; this vacancy does not establish AI-service buyers or willingness to pay.

feasibility.reason: A two-week mock can turn supplied fictional notes into a reviewable draft; no specific inputs, format or constraints are documented.

autonomy.reason: Draft assembly could repeat from operator-supplied notes, but no software reference supports it and a person must check facts and approve materials.

evidence.reason: The fresh paid notice explicitly names report and meeting-material preparation, but gives no frequency, inputs, constraints or corroboration.

candidates.reason: Assessed a bounded draft-preparation experiment from the explicit task. No attached building reference supports implementation, and the equal-weight mean is 4.6, below the threshold of 6; no post proposed.

rejected.title: Prepare administrator reports and meeting materials
rejected.reason: The notice supports report and meeting-material preparation as human work, but no attached building reference supports the proposed draft workflow. The five provisional scores average 4.6, below the threshold of 6; no post proposed.

steps.message: Assessed the sole enriched demand lead. Its literal report-preparation task supports a fictional-input draft experiment, but implementation evidence is absent and its provisional mean is below threshold; no post proposed.
